rows.commentary: 6.5: Linsey Smith floats it up and Anika Learoyd sweeps it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
6.6: Linsey Smith darts one in and Heather Knight clips it toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
7.1: Heather Knight does not score off Heather Graham.
7.2: No run for Heather Knight off Heather Graham.
7.3: No run for Heather Knight off Heather Graham.
7.4: Heather Graham targets the pads and Heather Knight works it away neatly to backward square leg for one.
7.5: Heather Graham drops short and Anika Learoyd collects a single out in the deep at mid-wicket.
7.6: Heather Graham offers width and Heather Knight steers it through the ring toward sweeper cover for a comfortable run.
8.1: No run for Heather Knight off Molly Strano.
8.2: Molly Strano loops it full and Heather Knight drives it down the ground to long-on for a single.
8.3: Molly Strano gets it through and Anika Learoyd cleverly guides it down to third man for a brisk couple.
8.4: Molly Strano pitches it up and Anika Learoyd detonates a powerful stroke all the way to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
8.5: Anika Learoyd does not score off Molly Strano.
8.6: Molly Strano bowls into the slot and Anika Learoyd picks up a single out in the deep at mid-wicket.
9.1: Nicola Carey bowls a wide to Anika Learoyd.
9.1: Anika Learoyd does not score off Nicola Carey.
9.2: Nicola Carey drifts it full and wide, allowing Anika Learoyd to thrash it through deep extra cover to find the fence for four.
9.3: Nicola Carey adjusts her length and Anika Learoyd taps it away toward sweeper cover to take a single.
18.5: Linsey Smith floats it up to Laura Harris, who turns the ball away toward deep square leg to scamper through for a single.
18.6: Linsey Smith keeps it tight, offering just a single as Nadine de Klerk pushes the delivery into extra cover.
19.1: Nicola Carey charges in and Nadine de Klerk sweeps it powerfully into the deep mid-wicket region to hustle back for a brisk two runs.
19.2: Nicola Carey darts this one in, nudged neatly by Nadine de Klerk toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
19.3: Laura Harris does not score off Nicola Carey.
19.4: Nicola Carey drops it short and Laura Harris collects a single by drilling it out to deep mid-wicket.
19.5: Wide from Nicola Carey to Nadine de Klerk.
19.5: Nicola Carey bowls full, allowing Nadine de Klerk to drive it out toward deep mid-wicket for one more run.
19.6: Nicola Carey strays on the pads and Laura Harris whips it away clinically behind square for a boundary.
0.1: Wide from Georgia Voll to Lizelle Lee.
0.1: Dot ball from Georgia Voll to Lizelle Lee.
0.2: Georgia Voll fires the opening salvo and Lizelle Lee eases it down to long-off to get off the mark with a single.
0.3: No run for Kate Pelle off Georgia Voll.
0.4: Kate Pelle does not score off Georgia Voll.
0.5: Kate Pelle does not score off Georgia Voll.
0.6: Georgia Voll completes the over as Kate Pelle works the ball away into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a comfortable single.
12.1: Georgia Voll bowls a wide to Rachel Trenaman.
12.1: Georgia Voll delivers to Rachel Trenaman, turning it away smoothly toward fine leg for a single.
12.2: Georgia Voll fires it in, and Nicola Carey works it square of the wicket to rotate the strike.
12.3: No run for Rachel Trenaman off Georgia Voll.
12.4: Georgia Voll floats one up, driven powerfully by Rachel Trenaman into the deep extra cover region for a brisk couple.
12.5: Georgia Voll keeps it tight, pushed gently by Rachel Trenaman out to sweeper cover to pick up one.
12.6: Georgia Voll slides it into Nicola Carey, who works it away cleanly toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
13.1: Lauren Bell steams in, but Nicola Carey deflects it deftly past the fielder all the way to the fine leg boundary for four.
13.2: Lauren Bell bangs it in, collected by Nicola Carey and pushed down to deep square leg for a comfortable run.
13.3: Rachel Trenaman does not score off Lauren Bell.
13.4: Lauren Bell overpitches, and Rachel Trenaman pounces, launching it straight down the ground with immense power for four.
13.5: Dot ball from Lauren Bell to Rachel Trenaman.
13.6: Lauren Bell bowls a wide to Rachel Trenaman.
13.6: Lauren Bell offers width, driven majestically by Rachel Trenaman toward long-off to collect another boundary.
14.1: Samantha Bates tosses it up, and Nicola Carey lofts it imperiously straight down the ground, racing away to the rope for four.
14.2: Samantha Bates drifts it on, worked neatly by Nicola Carey into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
14.3: Samantha Bates searches for turn, but Rachel Trenaman sweeps or glances it fine, finding the boundary rope at fine leg.
14.4: Samantha Bates offers width, and Rachel Trenaman pounces, driving powerfully through the carpet toward long-off for four.
14.5: Samantha Bates pushes it through, but Rachel Trenaman meets it with a clean bat-swing, piercing deep extra cover for another boundary.
14.6: A leg bye off Samantha Bates's delivery to Rachel Trenaman.
15.1: Jemma Barsby drops into the slot, and Rachel Trenaman extends handsomely to carve it square to the deep extra cover fence.
